newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady with soft undertone.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady with soft undertone.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were little changed from Thursday in thin talk, traders said on Friday.
Bunker 180-cst and 380-cst were quoted at $113-$115 and $108-$111 per tonne respectively by majors. Independents were at $112-$113 for 180-cst.
"There are some enquiries from shipowners but they are not in a hurry," said a major. "There is still oil around."
MDO and gas oil were quoted at $220 and $235 respectively.
